name: zolitron
description: This is the project of group zolitron-2

scripts.install:all: concurrently "cd client && npm i" "cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt"
scripts.setup:win: python -m venv backend/app/venv && cmd /c "backend\app\venv\Scripts\activate && pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && cd client && npm i"
scripts.setup:mac: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt && cd client && npm i"
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd client && npm run dev" "cd backend && backend\venv\Scripts\python -m fastapi dev" --kill-others --raw
